bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities within their production environments.
Established a shared responsibility operating framework clarifying AWS versus insurer-owned control boundaries, creating a repeatable trust model for partner-led deployments.
Led execution of AWS modernization efforts for monolithic policy administration and core insurance platform workloads, delivering production-grade migration outcomes.
